sentence: The law is the compass that has guided humans from the first law-abiding communities to where we are today.
translation: 法律是一枚罗盘，指引着人类从最早的守法社群一路走到今天。
analysis: the compass 定义式暗喻：法律=罗盘（方向感的意象）| that 定语从句 + 现在完成时 has guided：从远古“指引至今”的时间纵深 | from... to where we are today：from A to B 框架里 B 是 where 引导的宾语从句（“我们今天所在之处”——抽象地点）| law-abiding 复合形容词“守法的”（abide by 遵守）| 法治文明的开篇立意句：比喻+时间线+从句三合一——制度类话题作文的定义式开头
pattern: S + is the compass that has guided ... from ... to where we are today
imitationCn: 文字是一座桥梁，把人类从口耳相传的部落一路引到今天的知识社会。
imitationHint: Writing is the bridge that has carried humans from oral tribes → to where we are today（比喻+to where）
imitationAnswer: Writing is the bridge that has carried humans from oral tribes to where we are today.

sentence: After the amendment to the traffic law, drivers must make amends for any damage they cause.
translation: 交通法修订之后，司机必须对自己造成的任何损害作出赔偿。
analysis: amendment / amends 同根异义的一句双雄：amendment to 对……的修正案（法律语境）vs make amends for 赔偿、弥补（固定短语，amends 恒复数）——一字之差、词性词义全变，辨析式记忆的绝佳载体 | any damage (that) they cause 省略关系词定从 | must 法律义务的情态词 | 法条语体句：修法（因）→ 担责（果）——法律与责任单元的枢纽句
pattern: After the amendment to ..., S + must make amends for + any + N + (that) + S + cause
imitationCn: 校规修订之后，损坏公物的同学必须为造成的损失作出弥补。
imitationHint: After the amendment to the school rules, students who damage public property → must make amends for the losses they cause（amendment vs amends）
imitationAnswer: After the amendment to the school rules, students who damage public property must make amends for the losses they cause.

sentence: A hard-working, law-abiding and peace-loving citizen is a pillar of society.
translation: 一个勤奋工作、遵纪守法、热爱和平的公民，是社会的支柱。
analysis: 三复合形容词排比作定语：hard-working（adv.+v-ing）/ law-abiding（n.+v-ing）/ peace-loving（n.+v-ing）——“名词/副词+现在分词”构词法的集中展示（同族：English-speaking、time-consuming）| a pillar of society 社会支柱（pillar 柱石的比喻）| 公民素养的画像句：三个连字符形容词把“好公民”的三面（勤奋/守法/爱和平）钉进一个名词短语——人物评价与构词法双教学点
pattern: A + 复合adj., 复合adj. and 复合adj. + N + is a pillar of ...
imitationCn: 一个善于倾听、乐于助人、勇于担当的班干部，是班级的支柱。
imitationHint: A good-listening, help-offering and duty-taking class cadre → is a pillar of the class（三复合形容词；可灵活构词）
imitationAnswer: An attentive, helpful and responsibility-taking class cadre is a pillar of the class.
